data.title: Payment Reminder – Utility Cost Statement 2024 Balance Due
data.summary: Hausverwaltung Muster & Partner (property management) sends Aylin Musterfrau a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) for an unpaid balance of 286.14 EUR from the 2024 utility cost statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung), requesting payment by Friday, 27 February 2026.
data.explanation: Your property management says the extra payment (Nachzahlung) from your 2024 utility cost statement of 286.14 EUR has not arrived yet. Please transfer this amount to the IBAN shown by the date given. If you already paid, the letter states it can be disregarded. This is a private reminder from your Hausverwaltung, not an official government notice, so there is no formal legal appeal process attached — if you disagree with the amount, contact them directly, and consider professional advice if the underlying statement itself is disputed.
